name: Rapyd Bug Bounty

program_type.summary: The official brief advertises monetary bounties.

rewards.summary: Ordinary tiers advertise USD 100–7,500, 100–5,500 and 100–3,000. Impact-based increases and a minimum $500 payment-data bonus are separate; no combined ceiling established. The May–June 2026 SSO promotion expired.

eligibility.summary: Researcher identification, program-compliant accounts and concrete evidence are required. Platform first-valid-report rules apply; monetary compensation requires age 18 or the applicable age of majority.

restrictions.summary: Owned accounts only. Stop on nonpublic-data access and delete retained information. No form automation, social engineering, disruption or third-party evidence hosting. Public disclosure is prohibited.

submission_status.summary: The official brief explicitly displays In progress and an ongoing period.

limitations: Brief revision: June 17, 2026. Change index: page 1 of 4; diffs unreviewed.
Announcement index reviewed; recent notices read within the brief. Attachments, linked setup documentation and authenticated eligibility unreviewed.
USD uses platform accounting evidence. Static text omitted the brief. Inventories/instructions omitted; live terms prevail. No authorization granted.
rights: Original summary CC BY 4.0; linked sources and trademarks retain their own rights.

scope_context.included_summary: Selected payment APIs, merchant-management, identity-verification and checkout services; API coverage is restricted to sandbox environments.
scope_context.excluded_summary: Unlisted/third-party services, known SSO findings, self-imposed identity-provider weaknesses and specified low-impact classes are excluded. Out-of-scope reports may be accepted without rewards.
